changes.title: Added Ghost Hand (World) to break or interact with cobwebs and custom selected blocks straight through players (Always / Hold Key, Players Only, Item Whitelist)
Added Auto Drain (Combat) to automatically drain enemy water and lava sources using Empty Buckets, Cobwebs, or Solid Blocks with Legit / Silent swaps, rotations, and lake protection
Added Trigger Bot Hit Mode (Always, Only Crit, Prioritize Crit, Crits + Sprint) for full control over crit and sprint-hit timing
Added Trigger Bot Don't Break Blocks option while using Hold Attack (automatically yields to Ghost Hand when targeting cobwebs/blocks)
Improved Aim Assist with a dedicated Hold Attack option and reliable keybind detection
Fixed Spear Lunge Keypress mode not showing attack click inputs on CPS counters and Keystrokes overlays
Unhid Pearl Grapple in the Utility category so it is directly configurable from ClickGUI
